user_contract.automatic: Built-in and independent of UI refresh preferences or API connectivity. Healthy sessions are not restarted by health checks.
user_contract.force_refresh: Manual Refresh Now and Scheduled Refresh remain explicit disruptive reconnect controls, with existing server/UI behavior unchanged.

implementation.agent: Independent local 30-second monitor of authenticated control liveness; private local health snapshot. No API requests or settings needed to run.
implementation.client_transport: Bound control/data establishment and local target dialing; preserve established data tasks when control reconnects. Preserve partially-read control command across check notifications.
implementation.gateway: Negotiate optional data-carrier health support. Probe only idle carriers with bounded acknowledgement; validate readiness before committing a new visitor. Replace proven-stale carriers without resetting a mapping or active transfers.
implementation.compatibility: Existing native/Go wire discriminants unchanged; extension variants appended. Legacy clients remain supported; new client falls back to legacy gateway control handshake.
implementation.security: Policy removal, token rotation and explicit shutdown retain existing revocation semantics. No application request bodies are replayed.

ui_fixes.bindings: Replace unsupported border-primary/35 with supported border-primary/40; selected binding no longer falls back to a pale border in dark mode.
ui_fixes.description: Remove default textarea border and pointer-focus outline/ring; use subtle focus background while retaining the app keyboard-focus convention.

new_transport_tests: healthy checks preserve serving tunnel and control identity
expired control reconnects while established transfer continues
silent idle-pool blackhole recovers with same mapping/control
new client interoperates with legacy gateway handshake
verification.local_monitor_test: Checks continue without API/UI preferences; clearing revoked handles stops supervision.
verification.existing_regressions: Agent runtime/API-backoff failover, endpoint rerouting, revocation, embedded reload/UDP/half-close/framing, and UI utility tests.
verification.browser: Chromium dark/light1440/402/320; WebKit dark/light402/320. Computed styles assert selected dark binding accent and description border/focus appearance.
